old_version.title: Prior Authorization Policy — Outpatient Services (Sample, v1)

new_version.title: Prior Authorization Policy — Outpatient Services (Sample, v2 - UPDATED)

changes_summary:
- **Threshold for Prior Authorization:** Increased from 12 visits to 20 visits.
- **Deadline for Submission:** Reduced from 5 business days to 3 business days.
- **Visit Count for Submission:** Changed from "before the 13th visit" to "before the 21st visit."
impact_analysis:
[sop_001] AFFECTED: Updated visit threshold from 12 to 20.
[sop_002] AFFECTED: Updated visit threshold from 12 to 20 and submission window from 5 to 3 business days.
[sop_003] not affected: No related changes.

drafted_updates.original_text: Front desk staff verify visit count against the 12-visit prior authorization threshold before scheduling. If a patient exceeds 12 visits, flag for prior auth.
drafted_updates.draft_text: Front desk staff verify visit count against the 20-visit prior authorization threshold before scheduling. If a patient exceeds 20 visits, flag for prior auth. The prior auth must be submitted within 3 business days. The visit count for submission is before the 21st visit.
review_flags: The prior auth must be submitted within 3 business days.
The visit count for submission is before the 21st visit.

drafted_updates.original_text: Appeals for denied physical therapy claims must reference the prior authorization policy visit threshold and the 5-business-day submission window.
drafted_updates.draft_text: Appeals for denied physical therapy claims must reference the prior authorization policy visit threshold and the 3-business-day submission window. The threshold for prior authorization is increased to 20 visits, and the visit count for submission is changed to "before the 21st visit."
